title: Trial-to-trial handgrip laterality reversals provide no clear incremental prediction of grasp difficulty across independent NHANES cycles
abstract: A fixed indicator of stronger-hand reversals across three paired grip trials was evaluated against maximum grip, asymmetry, variation, trend and demographic predictors. Training used 1,429 NHANES 2011–2012 adults aged60+; independent-cycle testing used1,530 NHANES2013–2014 adults. Brier loss changed by -0.00000686, with both survey-bootstrap intervals spanning zero. The result does not establish equivalence or clinical validity.
